name: tprAt
doc: 真正率：在 OOD 集 `ood` 上，分数 `≥ t` 的比例（条件概率的计数版）。
stmt: def tprAt (s : α → ℝ) (ood : Finset α) (t : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ((ood.filter (fun x => t ≤ s x)).card : ℝ) / (ood.card : ℝ)

name: fprAt
doc:
假正率：在 ID 集 `id` 上，分数 `≥ t` 的比例。 ⚠ 参数名 `id` 与数学的
「恒等」无关；为避免与 `id` 函数混淆，此处用 `idset`。
stmt: def fprAt (s : α → ℝ) (idset : Finset α) (t : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ((idset.filter (fun x => t ≤ s x)).card : ℝ) / (idset.card : ℝ)

name: auroc
doc:
**AUROC（有序对计数 / Mann–Whitney 形式）**：
`(#{(o,i) | s o > s i} + ½ #{(o,i) | s o = s i}) / (|ood| * |id|)`。
即「随机取一个 OOD 与一个 ID，OOD 分数更高的概率（并列算 ½）」。

⚠ **G2 记法说明**：此处用 mathlib 的 `×ˢ`（`SProd`，`Finset.product` 的实例形式）
而非 `.product` 点记法 —— 二者**定义上相同**，但 `Finset.mem_product` 与
`Finset.card_product` 的**陈述**都用 `×ˢ` ⟹ 用点记法时 `rw` 找不到匹配模式
（v6 中 12 条 `did not find instance of the pattern (?s ×ˢ ?t).card` 即此因）。
stmt: def auroc (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α) : ℝ
proof:
(((ood ×ˢ idset).filter (fun p => s p.1 > s p.2)).card : ℝ)
    / ((ood.card : ℝ) * (idset.card : ℝ))
  + (1 / 2) * (((ood ×ˢ idset).filter (fun p => s p.1 = s p.2)).card : ℝ)
    / ((ood.card : ℝ) * (idset.card : ℝ))

name: sweepPoints
doc:
**扫掠所需的分位点集**：`OOD ∪ ID` 中出现的全部分数（`image s`）。
⚠ **G2 诚实标注**：原 docstring 称「`RealOODDetection` 证明它与 `auroc` 的计数定义
一致」——该定理**在本文件中并不存在**（文件头「诚实边界」亦已声明
「扫掠定义与有序对计数定义的相等性**未形式化**」）。此处按**实际存在**的内容
改写 docstring，避免 `check-xref` 意义上的悬空引用。
stmt: def sweepPoints (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α) : Finset ℝ
proof: (ood ∪ idset).image s

name: tpr_mono
stmt:
theorem tpr_mono (s : α → ℝ) (ood : Finset α) {t t' : ℝ} (h : t ≤ t') :
    tprAt s ood t' ≤ tprAt s ood t
proof:
by
  unfold tprAt
  have hsub : ood.filter (fun x => t' ≤ s x) ⊆ ood.filter (fun x => t ≤ s x) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx ⊢
    exact ⟨hx.1, le_trans h hx.2⟩
  have hcard : (ood.filter (fun x => t' ≤ s x)).card ≤ (ood.filter (fun x => t ≤ s x)).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card hsub
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: fpr_mono
stmt:
theorem fpr_mono (s : α → ℝ) (idset : Finset α) {t t' : ℝ} (h : t ≤ t') :
    fprAt s idset t' ≤ fprAt s idset t
proof:
by
  unfold fprAt
  have hsub : idset.filter (fun x => t' ≤ s x) ⊆ idset.filter (fun x => t ≤ s x) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx ⊢
    exact ⟨hx.1, le_trans h hx.2⟩
  have hcard : (idset.filter (fun x => t' ≤ s x)).card ≤ (idset.filter (fun x => t ≤ s x)).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card hsub
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: roc_trajectory_mono
doc:
**TPR 与 FPR 同调**：阈值提高时两者同时不增——ROC 曲线单调下降的
轨迹性质（曲线的「形状」由这条保证）。
stmt:
theorem roc_trajectory_mono (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α) {t t' : ℝ} (h : t ≤ t') :
    tprAt s ood t' ≤ tprAt s ood t ∧ fprAt s idset t' ≤ fprAt s idset t
proof: ⟨tpr_mono s ood h, fpr_mono s idset h⟩

name: auroc_nonneg
stmt:
theorem auroc_nonneg (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α) :
    0 ≤ auroc s ood idset
proof:
by
  unfold auroc
                                            
                                                              
                                          
                                                          
                                          
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (ood.card : ℝ) * (idset.card : ℝ) :=
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (((ood ×ˢ idset).filter (fun p => s p.1 > s p.2)).card : ℝ)
      / ((ood.card : ℝ) * (idset.card : ℝ)) :=
    div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hden
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2) * (((ood ×ˢ idset).filter (fun p => s p.1 = s p.2)).card : ℝ)
      / ((ood.card : ℝ) * (idset.card : ℝ)) := by
                                                 
                                                             
                                                               
                                                                      
                                                                      
    exact div_nonneg (by positivity) hden
  linarith

name: auroc_le_one
doc:
**AUROC ≤ 1**：两个不相交纤维（严格大于 / 相等）的计数之和
≤ 全部有序对计数。证明：两纤维不相交且并 ⊆ 全对集，
三个计数都是 ℕ，转 ℝ 后同除正的分母。
stmt:
theorem auroc_le_one (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α) :
    auroc s ood idset ≤ 1
proof:
by
  classical
                                                   
                                                                          
                                                                     
                                                                          
                                      
                                                               
                                                     
  unfold auroc
  set P : Finset (α × α) := ood ×ˢ idset with hP
  set G : Finset (α × α) := P.filter (fun p => s p.1 > s p.2) with hG
  set E : Finset (α × α) := P.filter (fun p => s p.1 = s p.2) with hE
                                                
  have hdisj : Disjoint G E := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro p hpG hpE
    rw [hG] at hpG
    rw [hE] at hpE
    have h1 : s p.1 > s p.2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpG).2
    have h2 : s p.1 = s p.2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpE).2
    linarith
              
  have hsub : G ∪ E ⊆ P := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_union] at hp
    rcases hp with hp | hp
    · rw [hG] at hp; exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
    · rw [hE] at hp; exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
                                       
  have hcard : G.card + E.card ≤ P.card := by
    rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
    exact Finset.card_le_card hsub
                                   
  have hPcard : P.card = ood.card * idset.card := by
    rw [hP, Finset.card_product]

name: auroc_symmetric_tie
doc:
**全并列时 AUROC = 1/2**：若所有 OOD 与 ID 分数相同（且两组**均非空**），
则 `auroc = 1/2`（有序对全在「相等」纤维，占 ½ 权重）。

⚠ **非空性不可省**：若两组中有空集，则 `|ood|·|id| = 0`，
由 Lean 的 `x/0 = 0` 得 `auroc = 0 ≠ 1/2`——故 `hoodne`/`hidne` 是
**必要假设**（机器核对：空集情形 `auroc = 0`）。
stmt:
theorem auroc_symmetric_tie (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α)
    (htie : ∀ o ∈ ood, ∀ i ∈ idset, s o = s i)
    (hoodne : ood.Nonempty) (hidne : idset.Nonempty) :
    auroc s ood idset = 1 / 2
proof:
by
  classical
  unfold auroc
  have hstrict : (ood ×ˢ idset).filter (fun p => s p.1 > s p.2) = ∅ := by
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨ho, hi⟩, hgt⟩ := hp
    rw [htie _ ho _ hi] at hgt
    exact lt_irrefl _ hgt
  have htieall : (ood ×ˢ idset).filter (fun p => s p.1 = s p.2) = ood ×ˢ idset := by
    apply Finset.filter_true_of_mem
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_product] at hp
    exact htie _ hp.1 _ hp.2
  rw [hstrict, htieall, Finset.card_product]
  simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
  push_cast
                          
  have h1 : 0 < ood.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hoodne
  have h2 : 0 < idset.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hidne
  have hca : (0 : ℝ) < (ood.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have hcb : (0 : ℝ) < (idset.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
  have hN : ((ood.card : ℝ) * (idset.card : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (mul_pos hca hcb)
                                    
                                                                              
                                                            
                                                       
                                                              
  have h1' : (1 : ℝ) / 2 * ((ood.card : ℝ) * (idset.card : ℝ)) / ((ood.card : ℝ) * (idset.card : ℝ))
      = (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
    rw [mul_div_assoc, div_self hN, mul_one]
  rw [zero_add]; exact h1'

name: separation_from_threshold
stmt:
theorem separation_from_threshold (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α) {t : ℝ}
    (hood : ∀ o ∈ ood, t ≤ s o) (hid : ∀ i ∈ idset, ¬ (t ≤ s i))
    (hoodne : ood.Nonempty) (hidne : idset.Nonempty) :
    tprAt s ood t = 1 ∧ fprAt s idset t = 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · unfold tprAt
    have hfilter : ood.filter (fun x => t ≤ s x) = ood :=
      Finset.filter_true_of_mem (fun x hx => hood x hx)
    rw [hfilter]
    exact div_self (by
      have : 0 < ood.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hoodne
      positivity)
  · unfold fprAt
    have hfilter : idset.filter (fun x => t ≤ s x) = ∅ := by
      rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      intro x hx
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
      exact hid x hx.1 hx.2
    rw [hfilter]
    simp

name: perfect_separation_auroc_one
doc:
**完全分离 ⟹ AUROC = 1**：若 OOD 分数**逐点严格大于** ID 分数，
则所有 `|ood|·|id|` 个有序对都在「严格大于」纤维，故 `auroc = 1`。
stmt:
theorem perfect_separation_auroc_one (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α)
    (hsep : ∀ o ∈ ood, ∀ i ∈ idset, s i < s o)
    (hoodne : ood.Nonempty) (hidne : idset.Nonempty) :
    auroc s ood idset = 1
proof:
by
  classical
  unfold auroc
  have hstrict : (ood ×ˢ idset).filter (fun p => s p.1 > s p.2) = ood ×ˢ idset := by
    apply Finset.filter_true_of_mem
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_product] at hp
    exact hsep _ hp.1 _ hp.2
  have htie : (ood ×ˢ idset).filter (fun p => s p.1 = s p.2) = ∅ := by
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨ho, hi⟩, heq⟩ := hp
    have := hsep _ ho _ hi
    linarith
  rw [hstrict, htie]
  simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
                                                                        
                                                   
                                                                        
                                                                          
                                         
  rw [Finset.card_product, Nat.cast_mul]
  have h1 : 0 < ood.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hoodne
  have h2 : 0 < idset.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hidne
  have hca : (0 : ℝ) < (ood.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have hcb : (0 : ℝ) < (idset.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
  have hne : ((ood.card : ℝ) * (idset.card : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (mul_pos hca hcb)
                                                          
                                            
                                                    
                                                             
                                   
  simp

name: auroc_ge_half_false
doc:
**`auroc ≥ 1/2` 的反例**：存在分数使 `auroc = 0 < 1/2`。
构造：`ood = {0}`（分数 `0`）、`idset = {1}`（分数 `1`）。
stmt:
theorem auroc_ge_half_false :
    ∃ (s : Fin 2 → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset (Fin 2)),
      ood.Nonempty ∧ idset.Nonempty ∧ auroc s ood idset < 1 / 2
proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun i => (i : ℝ), {0}, {1}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨0, Finset.mem_singleton_self 0⟩
  · exact ⟨1, Finset.mem_singleton_self 1⟩
  ·                                                 
                                                   
                                                           
                                                     
                                        
                                                              
                                                
                                                      
                                                               
    simp only [auroc]
    have hstrict : Finset.filter (fun p : Fin 2 × Fin 2 => (p.1 : ℝ) > (p.2 : ℝ))
        (({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ×ˢ {1}) = ∅ := by
      rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp
      obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, hgt⟩ := hp
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at h1 h2
      rw [h1, h2] at hgt
      norm_num at hgt
    have htie : Finset.filter (fun p : Fin 2 × Fin 2 => (p.1 : ℝ) = (p.2 : ℝ))
        (({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ×ˢ {1}) = ∅ := by
      rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp
      obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, heq⟩ := hp
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at h1 h2
      rw [h1, h2] at heq
      norm_num at heq
    rw [hstrict, htie]
    simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, mul_zero]
    norm_num

name: auroc_zero_of_reverse_separation
doc:
**反例的定量强化**：只要 OOD 分数**逐点小于** ID 分数，
`auroc = 0`（而非仅某个例子）——故 `≥ 1/2` 的失效是**结构性的**，
不是边界情形。

**无需非空假设**：两个纤维都为空 ⟹ 分子为 `0`，而 `0 / N = 0`（`N = 0`
时 `0/0 = 0` 在 ℝ 中成立），故结论无条件成立。
stmt:
theorem auroc_zero_of_reverse_separation (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α)
    (hsep : ∀ o ∈ ood, ∀ i ∈ idset, s o < s i) :
    auroc s ood idset = 0
proof:
by
  unfold auroc
  have hstrict : (ood ×ˢ idset).filter (fun p => s p.1 > s p.2) = ∅ := by
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨ho, hi⟩, hgt⟩ := hp
    have := hsep _ ho _ hi
    linarith
  have htie : (ood ×ˢ idset).filter (fun p => s p.1 = s p.2) = ∅ := by
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨ho, hi⟩, heq⟩ := hp
    have := hsep _ ho _ hi
    linarith
  rw [hstrict, htie]
  simp

name: threshold_separation_iff
stmt:
theorem threshold_separation_iff (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α)
    (hoodne : ood.Nonempty) :
    (∃ t : ℝ, (∀ o ∈ ood, t ≤ s o) ∧ (∀ i ∈ idset, ¬ (t ≤ s i)))
      ↔ (∀ o ∈ ood, ∀ i ∈ idset, s i < s o)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, hood, hid⟩ o ho i hi
    have h1 := hood o ho
    have h2 := hid i hi
    push_neg at h2
    linarith
  · intro hsep
                                             
                                                                     
                                                   
                                      
                                                                     
    refine ⟨(ood.inf' hoodne s), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro o ho
      exact Finset.inf'_le (s := ood) (f := s) ho
    · intro i hi
                                                                   
                                                         
                                                           
                                                                     
                                                                           
                                                                  
                
      exact not_le.mpr ((Finset.lt_inf'_iff _).mpr (fun o ho => hsep o ho i hi))

name: exists_separating_threshold
doc:
定理 5 的**推论（存在性）**：若 OOD 非空且「所有 ID 分数 < 所有 OOD 分数」，
则存在完美分离阈值。
stmt:
theorem exists_separating_threshold (s : α → ℝ) (ood idset : Finset α)
    (hoodne : ood.Nonempty)
    (hsep : ∀ o ∈ ood, ∀ i ∈ idset, s i < s o) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, (∀ o ∈ ood, t ≤ s o) ∧ (∀ i ∈ idset, ¬ (t ≤ s i))
proof:
(threshold_separation_iff s ood idset hoodne).mpr hsep

end Lattice

name: pacBayesRisk
doc: 风险：假设 `h` 在均匀数据分布下的期望损失 `E_z[loss h z]`。
stmt:
noncomputable def pacBayesRisk {Z : Type*} [Fintype Z] {k : ℕ} (loss : Fin k → Z → ℝ)
    (h : Fin k) : ℝ
proof: uniformExpectation (loss h)

name: pacBayesEmpRisk
doc: 经验风险：`(1/n)·Σᵢ loss h (w i)`（示例 `w : Fin n → Z`）。
stmt:
noncomputable def pacBayesEmpRisk {Z : Type*} {k n : ℕ} (loss : Fin k → Z → ℝ)
    (h : Fin k) (w : Fin n → Z) : ℝ
proof: (∑ i : Fin n, loss h (w i)) / (n : ℝ)

name: pacBayesPriorMoment
doc: 先验加权指数矩：`Σ_h P_h · e^{λ(R(h) − R̂(h,w))}`。
stmt:
noncomputable def pacBayesPriorMoment {Z : Type*} [Fintype Z] {k n : ℕ} (loss : Fin k → Z → ℝ)
    (P : Fin k → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) (w : Fin n → Z) : ℝ
proof: ∑ h : Fin k, P h * Real.exp (lam * (pacBayesRisk loss h - pacBayesEmpRisk loss h w))

name: pacBayesPosteriorRisk
doc: 后验风险：`E_{h~Q}[R(h)] = Σ_h Q_h R(h)`。
stmt:
noncomputable def pacBayesPosteriorRisk {Z : Type*} [Fintype Z] {k : ℕ} (loss : Fin k → Z → ℝ)
    (Q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ h : Fin k, Q h * pacBayesRisk loss h

name: pacBayesPosteriorEmpRisk
doc: 后验经验风险：`Σ_h Q_h R̂(h,w)`。
stmt:
noncomputable def pacBayesPosteriorEmpRisk {Z : Type*} {k n : ℕ} (loss : Fin k → Z → ℝ)
    (Q : Fin k → ℝ) (w : Fin n → Z) : ℝ
proof: ∑ h : Fin k, Q h * pacBayesEmpRisk loss h w

name: pacBayes_mgf_single
doc:
**n 个独立副本的锐利 Hoeffding MGF 界**：零均值、`|X| ≤ 1`、样本空间非空 ⟹
`E_w[e^{μ·ΣᵢX(wᵢ)}] ≤ exp(n·μ²/2)`。证明：乘积分解
（`Finset.prod_univ_sum`）把乘积空间的期望拆为单坐标期望之积，
每个因子用 `RealHoeffding.hoeffding_lemma`（常数 `μ²/2`）控制。
这是 `RealHoeffding.hoeffding_tail_bounded` 的「锐利版」——那里因
`|Y| ≤ 2`（均值平移）用了保守常数 2。
stmt:
theorem pacBayes_mgf_single {Z : Type*} [Fintype Z] {X : Z → ℝ} (n : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card Z) (hzero : (∑ z : Z, X z) = 0) (hb : ∀ z : Z, |X z| ≤ 1)
    (mu : ℝ) :
    uniformExpectation (fun w : Fin n → Z => Real.exp (mu * ∑ i : Fin n, X (w i))) ≤
      Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * mu ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
by
  have hfunc : (fun w : Fin n → Z => Real.exp (mu * (∑ i : Fin n, X (w i))))
      = fun w : Fin n → Z => ∏ i : Fin n, Real.exp (mu * X (w i)) := by
    funext w
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Real.exp_sum]
  calc
    uniformExpectation (fun w : Fin n → Z => Real.exp (mu * ∑ i : Fin n, X (w i)))
        = (∏ i : Fin n, ∑ z : Z, Real.exp (mu * X z)) / ((Fintype.card Z : ℝ) ^ n) := by
          unfold uniformExpectation
          rw [hfunc, Fintype.card_pi_const, Nat.cast_pow]
          congr 1
          rw [Finset.prod_univ_sum (t := fun _ : Fin n => (Finset.univ : Finset Z))
            (f := fun i z => Real.exp (mu * X z))]
          simp
    _ = ∏ i : Fin n, uniformExpectation (fun z => Real.exp (mu * X z)) := by
          unfold uniformExpectation
          rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]
          simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    _ ≤ ∏ _i : Fin n, Real.exp (mu ^ 2 / 2) := by
          apply Finset.prod_le_prod
          · intro i _
            unfold uniformExpectation
            exact div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun z _ => Real.exp_nonneg _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          · intro i _
            exact hoeffding_lemma hN hzero hb
    _ = Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * mu ^ 2 / 2) := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
          congr 1
          ring

name: pacBayes_mgf_hypothesis
doc:
**单假设的 PAC-Bayes MGF 界**：损失取值 `[0,1]`、`n > 0` 时，
`E_w[e^{λ(R(h) − R̂(h,w))}] ≤ exp(λ²/(2n))`。
证明：`X(z) = R(h) − loss h z`，`ΣX = 0`（因为 `R(h)` 是均值）、`|X| ≤ 1`
（`R(h), loss h z ∈ [0,1]`），对 `μ = λ/n` 用定理 `pacBayes_mgf_single`。
stmt:
theorem pacBayes_mgf_hypothesis {Z : Type*} [Fintype Z] (k n : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card Z) (hn : 0 < n)
    (loss : Fin k → Z → ℝ) (h01 : ∀ h z, 0 ≤ loss h z ∧ loss h z ≤ 1)
    (h : Fin k) (lam : ℝ) :
    uniformExpectation (fun w : Fin n → Z =>
        Real.exp (lam * (pacBayesRisk loss h - pacBayesEmpRisk loss h w))) ≤
      Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ)))

by

            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]

    intro z
    have hz := h01 h z

    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]

      = fun w : Fin n → Z => Real.exp ((lam / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i : Fin n, X (w i)) := by
    funext w

name: pacBayes_prior_moment_mgf
doc:
**先验加权指数矩的界**：`E_w[Σ_h P_h e^{λ(R(h) − R̂(h,w))}] ≤ exp(λ²/(2n))`。
证明：交换有限和（`Finset.sum_comm`）+ 每个假设的 MGF 界 + `Σ_h P_h = 1`。
stmt:
theorem pacBayes_prior_moment_mgf {Z : Type*} [Fintype Z] (k n : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card Z) (hn : 0 < n)
    (P : Fin k → ℝ) (loss : Fin k → Z → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ h, 0 < P h) (hPsum : ∑ h, P h = 1) (h01 : ∀ h z, 0 ≤ loss h z ∧ loss h z ≤ 1)
    (lam : ℝ) :
    uniformExpectation (fun w : Fin n → Z => pacBayesPriorMoment loss P lam w) ≤
      Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ)))
proof:
by
  have hpoint : ∀ h : Fin k,
      uniformExpectation (fun w : Fin n → Z =>
          Real.exp (lam * (pacBayesRisk loss h - pacBayesEmpRisk loss h w))) ≤
        Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) :=
    fun h => pacBayes_mgf_hypothesis k n hN hn loss h01 h lam
  have hstep : uniformExpectation (fun w : Fin n → Z => pacBayesPriorMoment loss P lam w)
      = ∑ h : Fin k, P h * uniformExpectation (fun w : Fin n → Z =>
          Real.exp (lam * (pacBayesRisk loss h - pacBayesEmpRisk loss h w))) := by
    unfold pacBayesPriorMoment uniformExpectation
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro h _
    have hmul : P h * (∑ w : Fin n → Z,
        Real.exp (lam * (pacBayesRisk loss h - pacBayesEmpRisk loss h w)))
        = ∑ w : Fin n → Z,
          P h * Real.exp (lam * (pacBayesRisk loss h - pacBayesEmpRisk loss h w)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [← hmul, mul_div_assoc]
  rw [hstep]
  calc ∑ h : Fin k, P h * uniformExpectation (fun w : Fin n → Z =>
          Real.exp (lam * (pacBayesRisk loss h - pacBayesEmpRisk loss h w)))
      ≤ ∑ h : Fin k, P h * Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun h _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpoint h) (le_of_lt (hP h)))
    _ = Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hPsum, one_mul]

name: pacBayes_change_of_measure
doc:
**变测度不等式**：对 `P, Q > 0`、`Σ_h Q_h = 1`、`k > 0`，
`Σ_h Q_h Z_h ≤ KL(Q‖P) + log(Σ_h P_h e^{Z_h})`，
其中 `KL(Q‖P) = kl Q P`（`RealKL.kl`，CE − H 形式）。

证明：令 `a_h = P_h e^{Z_h}/Q_h > 0`。加权 AM-GM
（`Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted`，权重 `Q_h`、和为 1）给出
`∏_h a_h^{Q_h} ≤ Σ_h Q_h a_h = Σ_h P_h e^{Z_h}`。两边取 log：
`Σ_h Q_h log a_h = log(∏ a_h^{Q_h}) ≤ log(Σ_h P_h e^{Z_h})`，
而 `log a_h = Z_h + log P_h − log Q_h`，故
`Σ_h Q_h log a_h = Σ_h Q_h Z_h − KL(Q‖P)`。
stmt:
theorem pacBayes_change_of_measure {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (P Q : Fin k → ℝ) (Z : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ h, 0 < P h) (hQ : ∀ h, 0 < Q h) (hQsum : ∑ h, Q h = 1) :
    (∑ h, Q h * Z h) ≤ kl Q P + Real.log (∑ h, P h * Real.exp (Z h))
proof:
by
  set a : Fin k → ℝ := fun h => P h * Real.exp (Z h) / Q h with ha
  have hapos : ∀ h, 0 < a h := fun h =>
    div_pos (mul_pos (hP h) (Real.exp_pos (Z h))) (hQ h)
  have hamgm : (∏ h ∈ Finset.univ, a h ^ (Q h)) ≤ ∑ h ∈ Finset.univ, Q h * a h :=
    Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted (s := Finset.univ) (w := Q) (z := a)
      (fun h _ => le_of_lt (hQ h)) hQsum (fun h _ => le_of_lt (hapos h))
  have harith : (∑ h ∈ Finset.univ, Q h * a h) = ∑ h, P h * Real.exp (Z h) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro h _
    simp only [ha]
    have hq : Q h ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hQ h)
    field_simp
  have hlog : ∀ h, Real.log (a h) = Z h + Real.log (P h) - Real.log (Q h) := by
    intro h
    simp only [ha]
    rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (mul_pos (hP h) (Real.exp_pos (Z h)))) (ne_of_gt (hQ h)),
        Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (hP h)) (Real.exp_ne_zero (Z h)), Real.log_exp]
    ring
  have hgeom : Real.log (∏ h ∈ Finset.univ, a h ^ (Q h)) = ∑ h, Q h * Real.log (a h) := by
    rw [Real.log_prod Finset.univ (fun h => a h ^ (Q h))
      (fun h _ => ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hapos h) (Q h)))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro h _
    rw [Real.log_rpow (hapos h)]
  have hgeom_eq : (∑ h, Q h * Real.log (a h)) = ∑ h, Q h * Z h - kl Q P := by
    have hstep : (∑ h, Q h * Real.log (a h))
        = ∑ h, Q h * (Z h + Real.log (P h) - Real.log (Q h)) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun h _ => by rw [hlog h])
    rw [hstep, kl_as_sum_log_sub_log]
    simp only [mul_sub, mul_add]

name: pacBayes_bound
doc:
**PAC-Bayes 违背事件概率界（主定理）**：有限假设集 `Fin k`、样本空间 `Z` 有限非空、
`n > 0`、先验 `P > 0` 且 `ΣP = 1`、后验 `Q > 0` 且 `ΣQ = 1`、损失取值 `[0,1]`、
`δ > 0`、`λ > 0`。其中 `hk : 0 < k` 承重（假设集非空）：证明需为 `Fin k` 取非空
见证 `⟨0, hk⟩` 以保证 `G(w) = Σ_h P_h e^{λ(R(h) − R̂(h,w))} > 0`，故 `k = 0` 不在覆盖范围内。
则「后验风险超过 后验经验风险 +
`(KL(Q‖P) + log(1/δ) + λ²/(2n))/λ`」这一**违背事件**的概率 ≤ δ ——
即 PAC-Bayes 界以置信度 `≥ 1 − δ` 成立。

证明：先验加权指数矩 `G(w) = Σ_h P_h e^{λ(R(h) − R̂(h,w))}` 满足
`E_w[G] ≤ exp(λ²/(2n))`（定理 `pacBayes_prior_moment_mgf`）；
马尔可夫（`RealHoeffding.markov_counting`）给出
`P(eps ≤ G) ≤ δ`，其中 `eps = (1/δ)·e^{λ²/(2n)}`。变测度不等式
（定理 `pacBayes_change_of_measure`）对 `Z_h = λ(R(h) − R̂(h,w))` 给出
`λ(Σ_h Q_h R(h) − Σ_h Q_h R̂(h,w)) ≤ KL(Q‖P) + log G(w)`，
故违背事件 ⊆ `{eps ≤ G}`，概率 ≤ δ。
stmt:
theorem pacBayes_bound {Z : Type*} [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z] (k n : ℕ)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card Z) (hn : 0 < n)
    (P Q : Fin k → ℝ) (loss : Fin k → Z → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ h, 0 < P h) (hPsum : ∑ h, P h = 1)
    (hQ : ∀ h, 0 < Q h) (hQsum : ∑ h, Q h = 1)
    (h01 : ∀ h z, 0 ≤ loss h z ∧ loss h z ≤ 1)
    {δ lam : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → Z =>
        pacBayesPosteriorRisk loss Q >
          pacBayesPosteriorEmpRisk loss Q w +
            (kl Q P + Real.log (1 / δ) + lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) / lam)) ≤ δ
proof:
by
  set G : (Fin n → Z) → ℝ := fun w =>
    ∑ h : Fin k, P h * Real.exp (lam * (pacBayesRisk loss h - pacBayesEmpRisk loss h w)) with hG
  set eps : ℝ := (1 / δ) * Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) with heps
  have hGnonneg : ∀ w, 0 ≤ G w :=
    fun w => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun h _ => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hP h)) (Real.exp_nonneg _))
  have hGpos : ∀ w, 0 < G w := by
    intro w
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun h _ => mul_pos (hP h) (Real.exp_pos _))
      ⟨⟨0, hk⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hE : uniformExpectation G ≤ Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) := by
    have h := pacBayes_prior_moment_mgf k n hN hn P loss hP hPsum h01 lam
    simpa [hG, pacBayesPriorMoment] using h
  have hepspos : 0 < eps := by
    rw [heps]
    exact mul_pos (div_pos one_pos hδ) (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hmarkov : uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → Z => eps ≤ G w)) ≤ δ := by
    calc uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → Z => eps ≤ G w))
        ≤ (1 / eps) * uniformExpectation G := markov_counting hepspos hGnonneg
      _ ≤ (1 / eps) * Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr hepspos))
      _ = δ := by
            rw [heps]
            field_simp
                  
  have hsub : Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → Z =>
        pacBayesPosteriorRisk loss Q >
          pacBayesPosteriorEmpRisk loss Q w +
            (kl Q P + Real.log (1 / δ) + lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) / lam)
      ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun w : F

name: pacBayes_risk_bound_of_exponent
doc:
**指数形式 ⟹ 风险形式**：若
`lam·(R_Q − R̂_Q(w)) ≤ KL(Q‖P) + log(1/δ) + λ²/(2n)`，
则风险形式的 PAC-Bayes 界成立。纯线性重排（除以 `lam > 0`）。
stmt:
theorem pacBayes_risk_bound_of_exponent {Z : Type*} [Fintype Z] {k n : ℕ}
    (P Q : Fin k → ℝ) (loss : Fin k → Z → ℝ) (w : Fin n → Z) {δ lam : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (h : lam * (pacBayesPosteriorRisk loss Q - pacBayesPosteriorEmpRisk loss Q w) ≤
      kl Q P + Real.log (1 / δ) + lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) :
    pacBayesPosteriorRisk loss Q ≤
      pacBayesPosteriorEmpRisk loss Q w +
        (kl Q P + Real.log (1 / δ) + lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) / lam
proof:
by
  have h2 : pacBayesPosteriorRisk loss Q - pacBayesPosteriorEmpRisk loss Q w
      ≤ (kl Q P + Real.log (1 / δ) + lam ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) / lam := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hlam]
    linarith [h]
  linarith
